fact: The Sierra Leone National Broadband Strategy (2023-2028) sets targets of broadband access for 50% of urban areas by 2027 and 95% by 2030 and rural connectivity of 80% by 2027, names UADF and government grants as funding for rural broadband, and provides for a steering committee with monitoring by the National Communications Authority.
title: Sierra Leone National Broadband Strategy (2023 - 2028)
publisher: Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation
